# Позитива Бар (Pozitiva Bar)

> Neighbourhood café by day and cocktail bar by night at Ѓорче Петров 3/1 (Gjorche Petrov 3/1), 1000 Skopje, North Macedonia. Open every day from 08:00 to 24:00. Opened September 2026. House motto: "Не служиме лошо расположение" (We don't serve bad moods).

## Key facts
- Address: Ѓорче Петров 3/1, 1000 Скопје, North Macedonia (Gjorche Petrov 3/1, Skopje). Coordinates 42.0069912, 21.3663834.
- Opening hours: Monday to Sunday, 08:00 to 24:00.
- Phone: +389 75 386 266
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pozitivabar/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5061748113390125551 (rated 4.5 from 14 reviews, October 2026)
- Prices are in Macedonian denars (MKD). Espresso 80 MKD, cappuccino 120 MKD, freddo espresso 170 MKD. Classic cocktails 210 to 290 MKD, signature cocktails 320 MKD.
- Signature cocktails: Drunk Monkey (rum, Jägermeister, banana, pineapple, vanilla, served in a monkey-head mug), Parrot's Kiss, Mamacita, Forest Animal, Tropical Mirage.
- Loyalty program: a free digital card for Apple Wallet or Google Wallet; every 10th coffee is free. Sign up: https://take.cards/lHclf
- The interior has a mural of a woman with hair made of greenery and round coral-tinted glasses, the bar's logo character.
